native=assemble(E12Compare.selected,on=@comparison/native-output1,along=E12Compare.interfaces,p=@comparison/plan)
planWithin=evaluate(E12Compare.within,p=@comparison/plan)
planProblem=prepare(E12Compare.allowed,using=E12Compare.choose,on=@comparison/plan,p=@comparison/plan)
planSolve=solve($planProblem.problem,within=$planWithin.value)
planPick0=candidate($planSolve.solutions,index=0)
planPick1=candidate($planSolve.solutions,index=1)
planApply0=apply($planPick0.assignment,in=$planSolve.solutions)
planApply1=apply($planPick1.assignment,in=$planSolve.solutions)
otherWithin=evaluate(E12Compare.within,p=@comparison/lookalike)
otherProblem=prepare(E12Compare.allowed,using=E12Compare.choose,on=@comparison/lookalike,p=@comparison/lookalike)
otherSolve=solve($otherProblem.problem,within=$otherWithin.value)
otherPick1=candidate($otherSolve.solutions,index=1)
otherApply1=apply($otherPick1.assignment,in=$otherSolve.solutions)
layout0=assemble(E12Compare.selected,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.interfaces,p=@comparison/plan,design.p=$planApply0.object)
layout1=assemble(E12Compare.selected,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.interfaces,p=@comparison/plan,design.p=$planApply1.object)
wrongIdentity=assemble(E12Compare.selected,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.interfaces,p=@comparison/plan,design.p=$otherApply1.object)
wrongDomain=apply($planPick1.assignment,in=$otherSolve.solutions)
migrate=assemble_map(E12Compare.routes,from=$native.assembly,to=$layout1.assembly,t=@comparison/move-T3)
wrongEndpoint=assemble_map(E12Compare.routes,from=$native.assembly,to=$layout0.assembly,t=@comparison/move-T3)
lawAfter=check(E12Compare.consumed,on=$migrate.map.target,s=@comparison/rust-T3-after)
planLabel=evaluate(E12Compare.labelOf,p=@comparison/plan)
otherLabel=evaluate(E12Compare.labelOf,p=@comparison/lookalike)
observedDesign=build(E12Compare,on=@comparison/plan)
wrongProvenance=assemble(E12Compare.selected,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.interfaces,p=@comparison/plan,design.p=$observedDesign.object)
